Ravi: spinning up monsoon18b-v2-int4 canary. seeing consistent coldstart OOMs on multi-turns when seq_len > 400. p50 ok, p99 fails during warm KV alloc. snippet below.

Ravi: ```
[2026-03-23T18:12:11Z] runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
model=monsoon18b-v2-int4 shard=1 seq_len=512 batch=1 new_tokens=150
context_alloc=95% kv_reserve=0.06 slab_frag=0.37
stack: serve.cc:198 alloc_kv.cu:77
```

Zoe: ugh. what's the canary policy right now (microbatch, warmstart, max_new_tokens, slot_reserve)?

Ravi: current canary config:```
model: monsoon18b-v2-int4
replicas: 6
microbatch_size: 1
batch_timeout_ms: 10
warmstart: enabled
warm_prefetch: full
max_new_tokens_default: 256
slot_reserve: 0.06
gradual_slowstart: disabled
soft_evict: off
```

Hector: looks like two things: full prefetch + low slot_reserve leaves almost no cushion for concurrent KV growth. Also warm_prefetch fully populates slabs at once -> fragmentation spikes. My quick suggestion: warm_prefetch=light (streamed), slot_reserve=0.16, max_new_tokens_default=120, enable gradual_slowstart to ramp batch concurrency and avoid big peak allocations. Also set kernel_pref=balanced to avoid overly memory-hungry kernels on shard 1. Example rollout:```
rollout set monsoon18b.canary {
  overrides: {
    warm_prefetch: "light",
    slot_reserve: 0.16,
    max_new_tokens_default: 120,
    gradual_slowstart: true,
    kernel_pref: "balanced",
    kv_sparse_trim: 0.2
  }
}
```

infra-bot: ALERT: node-gpu-7 memory-pressure at 2026-03-23T18:11:45Z. active_canary=monsoon18b-canary-1. free_mem falling below soft_reserve.

Maya: can we run a targeted quant-quality eval after the config changes? int4 rollout needs a quick semantic sim check vs int8 baseline. I'll run conversational-smoke + adversarial-ramble and save diffs. Command:```

```
I'll also kick off a 5k A/B with fallback set to monsoon18b-v2-int8 if quality regresses >2% semantic_sim. ETA 2h.
